markdown:
This guide to the best forex brokers in the Philippines compares **IG, Pepperstone, IC Markets, AvaTrade, Fusion Markets, Tickmill and BlackBull Markets**. No local retail forex/CFD authorisation or Philippine account eligibility is established here. Check the actual company and service permissions before comparing platforms or committing funds.

Read the [Philippine SEC’s investor advisories](https://www.sec.gov.ph/investor-education-and-information/advisories/). A foreign licence, Philippine-language page or convenient payment option does not establish permission to solicit local investors.

## How we selected these brokers

The seven brands come from the supplied research. We compare questions to investigate rather than award an overall best-broker score. No funded-account, execution or withdrawal tests were performed.

Before considering a live account, establish:

- The full legal company and the product it offers.
- Relevant local permissions and current advisories.
- Explicit Philippine resident eligibility.
- Complete fees, liability and client-money terms.
- The complaint and dispute jurisdiction.

## Forex trading regulations in the Philippines

The [Philippine SEC](https://www.sec.gov.ph/) and [Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas](https://www.bsp.gov.ph/) have different regulatory responsibilities. Ordinary currency exchange through a financial institution is not the same service as soliciting leveraged forex/CFD investments.

| Check | Why it matters |
|---|---|
| Exact company | A group brand can cover multiple legal entities |
| Relevant permission | General registration is not every financial-services permission |
| Foreign licence | Does not automatically establish Philippine authorisation |
| Product | Currency conversion, securities and CFDs differ |
| Payment channel | Availability does not authorise the underlying investment |

SEC pages returned access errors to our automated checks. Their current contents and the draft's specific advisory dates have not been independently verified. Obtain the exact notice or authoritative clarification before relying on a claim.

## Brokers named in Philippine SEC advisories

The supplied draft names several brands and warning dates without linking the individual notices. We have not matched those claims to official documents and do not reproduce them as established findings.

| Evidence needed | What to verify |
|---|---|
| Original notice | Official SEC URL and publication date |
| Named entity | Exact company, aliases and website |
| Activity and scope | What the notice actually says about the conduct |
| Current status | Corrections, later notices or relevant changes |

Do not infer that an advisory about one operation establishes the status of every similarly named company worldwide.

## What “best forex brokers in the Philippines” should mean

Start with a lawful service and eligible account. Then compare complete costs, usability, liability terms and support. Use our [platform guide](/insights/best-platforms-for-day-trading) and [forex calculator](/tools/forex-calculator) to understand features and charges without assuming eligibility.

## Philippine SEC protections explained

Check permissions and advisories separately. A company registration, overseas licence, testimonial or advertised loss-protection feature cannot replace the relevant local authorisation. Ask where a complaint could actually be pursued and which company owes the contractual obligations.

## Investor protection: what it covers

Client-money rules, deficit protection and firm-failure arrangements address different risks. Compensation eligibility is company/product-specific and does not automatically extend to every Philippine resident. No universal compensation limit or negative-balance guarantee is established here. Ordinary trading losses are not insured merely because a brand is regulated abroad.

## Payment methods in the Philippines

Check PHP/account-currency conversion, minimums, fees, account-name requirements and withdrawal conditions. A local payment processor does not establish permission for the underlying investment.

### Can traders use GCash or Maya?

Support for either service must be confirmed for the exact company, account and payment provider. A logo or successful payment is not proof that the broker may solicit Philippine investors. Do not send funds to a representative's personal account.

Our [position size calculator](/tools/forex-position-size-calculator) and [profit calculator](/tools/forex-profit-calculator) provide hypothetical calculations, not permission to transact.

## Red flags to avoid

- Claims of SEC approval without exact official evidence.
- Guaranteed profits or pressure to deposit.
- Payments to personal accounts or withdrawal-release charges.
- Overseas licences presented as Philippine authorisation.

## FAQs

### Is forex trading legal in the Philippines?

Ordinary currency exchange differs from leveraged forex/CFD investment services. This research has not established local authorisation or a lawful resident route for the shortlisted providers. Verify the exact activity and current requirements before participating.

### Which forex broker is best for beginners in the Philippines?

No overall beginner recommendation is established here. Resolve permissions and eligibility first, then compare demo usability, educational resources and complete costs. Popularity is not evidence of local authorisation.

### Can I use GCash or Maya to fund a forex account?

Availability depends on the actual broker company, account and payment provider. Confirm support and applicable restrictions directly. A payment method does not establish permission for the trading service.

## Final recommendation

Verify the exact company and current SEC position before choosing an account or transferring money. Use the seven-brand comparison to guide questions, not as a list of authorised Philippine providers. Leverage can cause rapid losses; do not risk essential savings.
